facts.fact: The Nation reports that Malawi's National Statistical Office has finalised the National Statistical System Strategic Plan (NSS SP IV) 2025-2030, covering 35 ministries, departments and agencies, with the NSO to oversee its implementation; the document gives no adoption date, so its published date is used.
